s.note: Hard-boiled eggs filled with creamy mustard yolk, each with a black olive eye and a dusting of smoked paprika
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, then peel and halve lengthways. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tsp Dijon mustard and season well. Spoon or pipe the filling back into the whites. Press half a pitted black olive into the middle of each for an eye, dust with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and scatter with chopped chives.

s.note: Frankfurts on sticks dipped in sweet polenta batter and fried golden, with tomato sauce and yellow mustard
s.how: Whisk 150g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and 1/2 tsp salt, then whisk in 1 egg and 250ml milk to a thick batter and pour into a tall glass. Heat 1.5 litres of vegetable oil in a deep heavy pan to 180C. Pat 8 frankfurts dry and push a bamboo skewer into each. Dip each in the batter and fry 2 or 3 at a time, turning, for about 3 minutes until deep golden. Drain on paper towel and serve hot with tomato sauce and yellow mustard.

m.n: Winifred's cauldron beef and pumpkin stew with herb dumplings
m.note: Slow-simmered beef with carrots and butternut pumpkin in a thick thyme gravy, with fluffy parsley dumplings steamed on top
m.how: Toss 1kg cubed beef chuck in 2 tbsp seasoned plain flour and brown in batches in 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot, then lift out. Soften 1 chopped brown onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 carrots in the pot, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 1 litre beef stock, 2 bay leaves and 1 tsp dried thyme. Return the beef, cover and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours. Add 600g butternut pumpkin chunks and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Rub 60g cold butter into 200g self-raising flour with 2 tbsp chopped parsley and a pinch of salt, stir in 150ml milk and roll into 8 balls. Sit them on the stew, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until puffed. Season and serve 2 dumplings to a bowl.

w.note: Dark chocolate puddings baked until just set outside with a molten middle, with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Brush four 200ml pudding moulds with soft butter and dust with cocoa. Melt 100g chopped dark chocolate with 100g butter over simmering water and cool slightly. Whisk 2 eggs, 2 egg yolks and 60g caster sugar until thick and pale, fold in the chocolate, then 2 tbsp plain flour, and divide between the moulds. Chill for 30 minutes. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes until risen with a soft wobble in the middle, stand for 1 minute, then turn out and serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Bright green kiwi, apple and lime with bruised mint, topped with lemonade and frozen grape eyeballs
d.how: Blend 4 peeled kiwifruit with 500ml apple juice and the juice of 1 lime until smooth, then strain into a jug, pressing on the pulp. Bruise half a bunch of mint and stir it in. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the green potion and top with 750ml lemonade. Garnish each glass with a skewer of 3 frozen green grapes, a lime wheel and a mint sprig.
